pages.text: A dim, dense forest of towering, self-lit $(l:glowing_woods)Glowroot$(/l) trees over a dark-teal floor. Their own glow is most of the light here, so the shadows between the trunks run deep.
That darkness hides $(l:native_fauna)Shade Stalkers$(/l), which flee any bright light you bring. Small root-cage shrines sometimes shelter a reward chest among the giant trees.
